doc: Party vitals out of battle (M1-ARC-06; docs/kb/tech/architecture.md, Saves). carried_statuses survive the end of a battle and are saved per member (GameStateData.party_vitals); every other status ends with the battle. They come back at the next battle setup with carried_duration (-1 = until cured, the engine's whole battle). shrine_cures are what a save shrine's rest removes (it also fills HP and MP, which lifts KO). Genre convention: poison, stone and zombie follow you out of a fight, and a shrine clears all three.
